displayName: Public Lands Field Guide: National Forest & BLM Camping
description: Plans camping and overlanding trips on US national forest and BLM land, the careful way, using the free American Adventurer records (about 19,000 sourced camps, no sign-in). Use when someone asks where to camp, how to plan a trip, free or dispersed camping, a town run, water, season, weather, wildfi
